description: Retrieval evaluation corpus. The papers are not redistributed: npm run eval:retrieval:fetch downloads each PDF from pdf_url, checks pdf_sha256, and writes the text produced by extractPdf (src/core/pdf.ts) to the git-ignored .cache/retrieval directory. text_sha256 is the text the question labels were made on.
changes: Plain text extracted automatically from the original PDF; figures, images, layout and typography removed; no other edits.
